primary_assets: biological sample | sequencer output | raw nanopore signal | POD5 or equivalent raw-signal files
primary_operations: sample acquisition | sequencing | signal measurement | raw-data generation
representative_failures: sample manipulation | malicious biological input | localized signal perturbation | raw-data corruption
scope_note: Begins when a biological sample or sequencer produces a digital raw-signal representation.

primary_assets: basecalled reads | FASTQ | basecall quality values | move-table metadata
primary_operations: signal-to-base translation | quality estimation | read segmentation
representative_failures: base substitution | insertion | deletion | read splitting | adversarial basecall degradation
scope_note: Covers transformation of raw sequencing signal into nucleotide reads.

primary_assets: SAM or BAM records | mapping coordinates | mapping quality | pileup evidence
primary_operations: reference alignment | read placement | evidence aggregation
representative_failures: memory-safety failure | incorrect alignment | evidence displacement | malformed-input processing
scope_note: Creates reference-relative evidence used by downstream variant callers.

primary_assets: VCF or BCF records | genotypes | allele support | variant quality
primary_operations: variant detection | genotype inference | call filtering
representative_failures: false-negative call | false-positive call | genotype alteration | call suppression
scope_note: Produces discrete variant and genotype records from aligned evidence.

primary_assets: annotated variants | clinical significance | condition associations | interpretive reports
primary_operations: database annotation | pathogenicity interpretation | clinical reporting
representative_failures: missed pathogenic variant | incorrect clinical interpretation | false reassurance | unsupported disease inference
scope_note: Maps computational calls to clinical or biological meaning. Project evidence represents potential interpretation risk and not a demonstrated patient diagnosis.

primary_assets: raw sequences | variant records | clinical annotations | derived genomic layers
primary_operations: database entry | vault storage | access control | selective disclosure
representative_failures: storage of corrupted records | unauthorized access | over-disclosure | insufficient unrecoverability
scope_note: This is the principal handoff from generation-time integrity risk to persistent storage and privacy risk.

primary_assets: shared genomic records | derived reports | research datasets | relative-matching outputs
primary_operations: data sharing | secondary analysis | platform disclosure | dataset replication
representative_failures: uncontrolled replication | purpose expansion | metadata leakage | propagation of corrupted information
scope_note: Covers movement of genomic information beyond its original storage or processing context.

primary_assets: kinship links | relative records | population graphs | relationship inferences
primary_operations: relative matching | kinship inference | graph traversal | population exposure propagation
representative_failures: non-consensual familial exposure | graph-amplified breach | relationship inference | population-scale propagation
scope_note: Represents risk expansion through biological relationships and platform graph structure.

primary_assets: replicated genomic data | identity linkages | historical disclosures | persistent biological identifiers
primary_operations: long-term retention | future database linkage | re-identification | cumulative secondary use
representative_failures: irreversible exposure | future re-identification | cumulative privacy loss | long-lived familial harm
scope_note: Models the time-dependent increase or persistence of genomic risk.

primary_assets: audit logs | trusted source data | containment boundaries | authentication evidence
primary_operations: detection | boundary isolation | access revocation | record recovery | provenance verification
representative_failures: late detection | insufficient containment | loss of trusted provenance | irrecoverable corrupted record
scope_note: Represents preventive and corrective controls across the lifecycle.
